newsitem.title: GERMANY: German agency to demerge from AP Lintas in 9 years.
newsitem.headline: German agency to demerge from AP Lintas in 9 years.

text.p: German advertising agency Baader, Lang, Behnken (BLB) said on Tuesday it planned to demerge from the German unit of ad group Ammirati Puris (AP) Lintas after nine years and buy back its majority shares.
BLB chief executive Fred Baader said the merger with Ammirati Puris Lintas GmbH had failed to be fruitful and had blurred its image in the German advertising industry.

"We were neither a purebred network agency nor an owner-led creative agency," BLB chief executive Fred Baader said. "This led to situations (with customers) in which we did not fit into either category."

Baader cited its unsuccessful pitch for automaker Volkswagen 's ad account as an example of this conflict. He added that the decision to merge with another agency that also had its base in Hamburg was "somewhat naive".
Baader said AP Lintas, a unit of Interpublic Group of Cos Inc, had indicated it was ready to sell its about 73 percent share in BLB but that they had not yet agreed on a price.
